claude.sample_unit: ChatGPT responses to standard and simplified questions on three ENT operations

links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT patient information (FRES) before and after simplification
links.effect: ChatGPT readability was poor, with mean FRES of 38.9 and 55.1 pre- and post-simplification, respectively; ENT UK leaflets were consistently more readable.
links.quote: ChatGPT readability was poor, with mean FRES of 38.9 and 55.1 pre- and post-simplification, respectively.

links.outcome: Reading level of ChatGPT patient information versus appropriate levels
links.effect: Mean FRES 38.9 standard and 55.1 simplified; readability poor; simplified was 43.6% more readable but ENT UK leaflets remained higher.
links.quote: ChatGPT readability was poor, with mean FRES of 38.9 and 55.1 pre- and post-simplification, respectively.

links.outcome: Quality of ChatGPT patient information (DISCERN) versus ENT UK leaflets, standard vs simplified
links.effect: Simplified ChatGPT information scored 11.6% lower for quality; ENT UK information quality was consistently higher; shorter answers had important omissions.
links.quote: Simplified information from ChatGPT was 43.6% more readable (FRES) but scored 11.6% lower for quality.
